name: TPL Plastech Limited
summary: TPL Plastech Limited is an Indian entity specializing in the production and distribution of intermediate bulk containers (IBCs). Its IBC offerings include the QuBC brand for new units and the COBO brand for reconditioned ones. The company's diverse product portfolio also features jerry cans, narrow-mouth drums, and both narrow and wide-mouth carboys, particularly catering to the specialty chemical and adhesive industries. Furthermore, they manufacture bulk and medium open-top drums, ideal for packaging powdered, pasty, or semi-liquid/solid substances. Beyond these, TPL Plastech supplies high-density polyethylene (HDPE) packaging in the form of bottles, used across various sectors such as lubricant oils, pesticides, cosmetics, food and beverages, and cleaning and hygiene products. The company extends its expertise to provide tailored packaging solutions for pharmaceutical, agro-based, cosmetics, and personal care industries, complemented by ancillary products like caps, closures, small containers, and promotional packaging. Founded in 1992 and based in Mumbai, India, TPL Plastech Limited operates as a subsidiary of Time Technoplast Limited.
